copy.tagline: 自动化游戏任务实现与调试流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在游戏开发中快速实现任务并捕获截图视频进行调试。
copy.tagline_en: Automate game task implementation and debugging workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly implement game tasks and capture screenshots/videos for debugging.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照游戏开发计划，依次实现风险任务和主构建，包括导入资源、生成场景和脚本、验证项目、捕获截图或视频，并修复错误。
howto.when: 当 Claude 需要实现一个游戏任务，且游戏计划已准备好时触发。通常在加载此技能后，开始执行游戏开发工作。

say.text: 实现这个游戏计划中的风险任务。
say.note: Claude 会先实现计划中标记为风险的功能。

say.text: 运行实现循环，直到验证通过。
say.note: Claude 会反复导入、生成、验证，直到满足条件。

say.text: 捕获游戏场景的截图和视频。
say.note: Claude 会生成测试截图和演示视频。

howto.what_en: After loading, Claude will follow the game development plan to implement risk tasks and main build, including importing assets, generating scenes and scripts, validating the project, capturing screenshots or videos, and fixing errors.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude needs to implement a game task and the game plan is ready. Typically after loading this skill, before starting game development work.

say_en.text: Implement the risk tasks in this game plan.
say_en.note: Claude will first implement features marked as risk in the plan.

say_en.text: Run the implementation loop until verification passes.
say_en.note: Claude will repeatedly import, generate, and validate until criteria are met.

say_en.text: Capture screenshots and video of the game scene.
say_en.note: Claude will generate test screenshots and a presentation video.
